import h5py
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import statsmodels.api as sm
from statsmodels.formula.api import mixedlm

# Parameters
sessions = range(1, 11)
sf = None
pre_t = 0.2
post_t = 0.8
bin_dur = 0.05
occ_codes = {17, 18, 19, 25, 26}

# Storage
lengths = []
latencies = []
session_ids = []
occ_sensors = None

for ses in sessions:
    # Load MEG
    with h5py.File(f"sub-0_ses-{ses}_meg.h5", 'r') as f:
        data = f['data'][:]
        times = f['times'][:]
        if sf is None:
            sf = f.attrs['sample_frequency']
        if occ_sensors is None:
            ch_names = [s.strip() for s in f.attrs['channel_names'].split(',')]
            occ_inds = []
            for i, name in enumerate(ch_names):
                if any(str(code) in name for code in occ_codes):
                    occ_inds.append(i)
            occ_sensors = [ch_names[i] for i in occ_inds]
    # Load events
    events = pd.read_csv(f"sub-0_ses-{ses}_events.tsv", sep='\t')
    words = events[(events.kind == 'word') & (events.timesentence == 0)]
    # Epoch parameters
    n_pre = int(round(pre_t * sf))
    n_post = int(round(post_t * sf))
    epoch_len = n_pre + n_post
    bin_size = int(bin_dur * sf)
    n_bins = epoch_len // bin_size
    centers = -pre_t + (np.arange(n_bins) + 0.5) * (bin_size / sf)
    valid_bins = np.where((centers >= 0) & (centers <= 0.5))[0]
    # Extract epochs
    for _, ev in words.iterrows():
        idx0 = np.searchsorted(times, ev.timemeg)
        start, end = idx0 - n_pre, idx0 + n_post
        if start < 0 or end > len(times):
            continue
        epoch = data[occ_inds, start:end]
        var_tc = [np.var(epoch[:, b*bin_size:(b+1)*bin_size], axis=1).mean()
                  for b in range(n_bins)]
        var_tc = np.array(var_tc)
        sel = var_tc[valid_bins]
        peak_bin = valid_bins[np.argmax(sel)]
        latencies.append(centers[peak_bin])
        lengths.append(len(ev.segment))
        session_ids.append(ses)

# Convert arrays
lengths = np.array(lengths)
latencies = np.array(latencies)
sessions_arr = np.array(session_ids)
lengths_z = (lengths - lengths.mean()) / lengths.std()

# Outputs
print("Occipital sensors:", occ_sensors)
print(f"Total epochs: {len(latencies)}")

# Word length distribution
plt.figure()
plt.hist(lengths, bins=20, color='skyblue', edgecolor='k')
plt.xlabel('Word length (chars)')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.title('Distribution of word lengths')
plt.show()

# Peak latency histogram
plt.figure()
plt.hist(latencies, bins=20, color='salmon', edgecolor='k')
plt.xlabel('Peak latency (s)')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.title('Histogram of latency to peak variance')
plt.show()

# Correlation
r, p_corr = stats.pearsonr(lengths_z, latencies)
print(f"Pearson r between z-scored length and latency: r = {r:.3f}, p = {p_corr:.3e}")

# Mixed-effects model
df = pd.DataFrame({'latency': latencies,
                   'length_z': lengths_z,
                   'session': sessions_arr})
df['session'] = df['session'].astype('category')
model = mixedlm('latency ~ length_z', df, groups=df['session'])
res = model.fit(reml=False)
print(res.summary())

# Scatter with regression line
slope, intercept = np.polyfit(lengths_z, latencies, 1)
line_x = np.linspace(lengths_z.min(), lengths_z.max(), 100)
line_y = intercept + slope * line_x
plt.figure()
plt.scatter(lengths_z, latencies, alpha=0.5)
plt.plot(line_x, line_y, color='red', label=f'y={slope:.3f}x+{intercept:.3f}')
plt.xlabel('Z-scored word length')
plt.ylabel('Peak latency (s)')
plt.title('Peak latency vs word length')
plt.legend()
plt.show()

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import statsmodels.api as sm

sf = None  # sampling frequency placeholder
pre_t = 0.2  # seconds before onset
post_t = 0.8  # seconds after onset
bin_dur = 0.05  # 50 ms windows
occ_codes = {17, 18, 19, 25, 26}

latencies = []       # peak latency
session_ids = []     # session for each epoch

    meg_fn = f"sub-0_ses-{ses}_meg.h5"

        data = f['data'][:]             # (306, n_samples)
        times = f['times'][:]           # (n_samples,)
        if sf is None:
            sf = f.attrs['sample_frequency']
        # channel names parse once
        if occ_sensors is None:
            ch_str = f.attrs['channel_names']
            # split into list
            ch_names = [s.strip() for s in ch_str.split(',')]
            # identify occ channels by code substring
            occ_inds = []
            for i, name in enumerate(ch_names):
                for code in occ_codes:
                    # heuristic: channel name contains the region code as full integer
                    if str(code) in name:
                        occ_inds.append(i)
                        break
            occ_sensors = [ch_names[i] for i in occ_inds]
    
    # Load events
    ev_fn = f"sub-0_ses-{ses}_events.tsv"
    events = pd.read_csv(ev_fn, sep='\t')
    words = events[(events.kind == 'word') & (events.timesentence == 0)]
    # prepare epoch indices
    n_pre = int(round(pre_t * sf))
    n_post = int(round(post_t * sf))
    epoch_len = n_pre + n_post
    # binning
    bin_size = int(bin_dur * sf)
    n_bins = epoch_len // bin_size
    # window centers
    centers = -pre_t + (np.arange(n_bins) + 0.5) * (bin_size / sf)
    # select bins in 0-0.5s
    valid_bins = np.where((centers >= 0) & (centers <= 0.5))[0]
    
    for _, ev in words.iterrows():
        t0 = ev.timemeg
        idx = np.searchsorted(times, t0)
        start = idx - n_pre

        # compute variance time course
        var_tc = []
        for b in range(n_bins):
            w0 = b * bin_size
            w1 = w0 + bin_size
            seg = epoch[:, w0:w1]
            # channel-wise variance then mean across channels
            v = np.var(seg, axis=1)
            var_tc.append(v.mean())
        var_tc = np.array(var_tc)
        # find peak in post-onset interval
        sel = var_tc[valid_bins]
        peak_bin = valid_bins[np.argmax(sel)]
        peak_time = centers[peak_bin]
        # record
        lengths.append(len(ev.segment))
        latencies.append(peak_time)
        session_ids.append(ses)

{"code":"import h5py
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import statsmodels.api as sm
from statsmodels.formula.api import mixedlm

# Parameters
sessions = range(1, 11)
sf = None
pre_t = 0.2
post_t = 0.8
bin_dur = 0.05
occ_codes = {17, 18, 19, 25, 26}

# Storage
lengths = []
latencies = []
session_ids = []
occ_sensors = None

for ses in sessions:
    # Load MEG
    with h5py.File(f"sub-0_ses-{ses}_meg.h5", 'r') as f:
        data = f['data'][:]
        times = f['times'][:]
        if sf is None:
            sf = f.attrs['sample_frequency']
        if occ_sensors is None:
            ch_names = [s.strip() for s in f.attrs['channel_names'].split(',')]
            occ_inds = []
            for i, name in enumerate(ch_names):
                if any(str(code) in name for code in occ_codes):
                    occ_inds.append(i)
            occ_sensors = [ch_names[i] for i in occ_inds]
    # Load events
    events = pd.read_csv(f"sub-0_ses-{ses}_events.tsv", sep='\t')
    words = events[(events.kind == 'word') & (events.timesentence == 0)]
    # Epoch parameters
    n_pre = int(round(pre_t * sf))
    n_post = int(round(post_t * sf))
    epoch_len = n_pre + n_post
    bin_size = int(bin_dur * sf)
    n_bins = epoch_len // bin_size
    centers = -pre_t + (np.arange(n_bins) + 0.5) * (bin_size / sf)
    valid_bins = np.where((centers >= 0) & (centers <= 0.5))[0]
    # Extract epochs
    for _, ev in words.iterrows():
        idx0 = np.searchsorted(times, ev.timemeg)
        start, end = idx0 - n_pre, idx0 + n_post
        if start < 0 or end > len(times):
            continue
        epoch = data[occ_inds, start:end]
        var_tc = [np.var(epoch[:, b*bin_size:(b+1)*bin_size], axis=1).mean()
                  for b in range(n_bins)]
        var_tc = np.array(var_tc)
        sel = var_tc[valid_bins]
        peak_bin = valid_bins[np.argmax(sel)]
        latencies.append(centers[peak_bin])
        lengths.append(len(ev.segment))
        session_ids.append(ses)

# Convert arrays
lengths = np.array(lengths)
latencies = np.array(latencies)
sessions_arr = np.array(session_ids)
lengths_z = (lengths - lengths.mean()) / lengths.std()

# Outputs
print("Occipital sensors:", occ_sensors)
print(f"Total epochs: {len(latencies)}")

# Word length distribution
plt.figure()
plt.hist(lengths, bins=20, color='skyblue', edgecolor='k')
plt.xlabel('Word length (chars)')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.title('Distribution of word lengths')
plt.show()

# Peak latency histogram
plt.figure()
plt.hist(latencies, bins=20, color='salmon', edgecolor='k')
plt.xlabel('Peak latency (s)')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.title('Histogram of latency to peak variance')
plt.show()

# Correlation
r, p_corr = stats.pearsonr(lengths_z, latencies)
print(f"Pearson r between z-scored length and latency: r = {r:.3f}, p = {p_corr:.3e}")

# Mixed-effects model
df = pd.DataFrame({'latency': latencies,
                   'length_z': lengths_z,
                   'session': sessions_arr})
df['session'] = df['session'].astype('category')
model = mixedlm('latency ~ length_z', df, groups=df['session'])
res = model.fit(reml=False)
print(res.summary())

# Scatter with regression line
slope, intercept = np.polyfit(lengths_z, latencies, 1)
line_x = np.linspace(lengths_z.min(), lengths_z.max(), 100)
line_y = intercept + slope * line_x
plt.figure()
plt.scatter(lengths_z, latencies, alpha=0.5)
plt.plot(line_x, line_y, color='red', label=f'y={slope:.3f}x+{intercept:.3f}')
plt.xlabel('Z-scored word length')
plt.ylabel('Peak latency (s)')
plt.title('Peak latency vs word length')
plt.legend()
plt.show()"}
